title: Build your own long-term investing system in one year
intro: Long-term investing is a skill, not a tip. In twelve months of personal coaching you build your own system, step by step, and learn to run it on your own.

deliverables.title: Investment Policy Statement
deliverables.text: Your personal rules and principles, written down and rewritten every quarter as your skill grows.

deliverables.title: Investment plan
deliverables.text: How you apply those rules: your allocation, your process and how you review it.

deliverables.title: Crash plan and selling rules
deliverables.text: What you do when markets fall, and when you sell, decided in advance and not in the moment.

deliverables.title: Decision journal
deliverables.text: A record of every decision you made and why, so you learn from your own choices.

how.title: A paper portfolio from week 1
how.text: You practice real decisions from the start, without risking money. It's about the quality of your decisions, not returns.

how.title: Weekly and monthly assignments
how.text: Every week you do something concrete, so the skill builds steadily.

how.title: Valuation and thesis defense
how.text: You learn how to value businesses and how to defend your investment theses.

how.title: 1:1 coaching
how.text: Regular personal sessions and quarterly reviews, with support in between.

how.title: Education, not advice
how.text: I teach you how to make your own decisions. I never tell you what to buy or sell.

year_note: Every quarter ends with a review, and you rewrite your Investment Policy Statement.

faq.question: Is this investment advice?
faq.answer: No. This is education and coaching. I teach you how to build and follow your own investing framework. I never give buy or sell recommendations for specific securities.

faq.question: Who is this program for?
faq.answer: For people who are already familiar with the financial markets and want to develop the skill of disciplined long-term investing.

faq.question: How long does the program last?
faq.answer: 12 months. Real skills take time, so we work together long enough for your system to be tested in real markets.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: Pricing and the founding offer are presented at the free workshop on 29 October.

faq.question: Is the coaching online?
faq.answer: Yes. All sessions take place online, so you can join from anywhere.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Join the free workshop on 29 October. Afterwards you can book a personal intro call.

cta_text: Both are presented at the free workshop on Thursday 29 October.
seo_title: 12-Month Coaching Program in Long-Term Investing | Lenny Winnemuller
seo_description: A 12-month coaching program in which you build your own long-term investing system: an Investment Policy Statement, investment plan, crash plan and decision journal. Education, no investment advice.
